courses.title: Basic Computer & Internet Literacy
courses.prereq: None — designed for absolute first-time users.
courses.bestFor: Seniors, homemakers, and Tier-2/3 learners entering the digital economy.
courses.brief: Computers, files, the web, email and staying safe online, with a practice lab in every module.
learn: The parts of a computer, software and how storage is measured
Files, folders, naming and the shortcuts that save time
How the internet works, using a browser and searching well
Writing clear emails and sharing files safely
Strong passwords, 2-step verification, scams, updates and backups
Safe online services, fixing common problems and learning new tools
courses.handsOn: Write a one-page digital safety card for your family with rules, warning signs and steps to take.
courses.outcome: Use a computer and the internet with confidence, and keep yourself and your money safe.

courses.title: Basic Microsoft Excel
courses.bestFor: Anyone entering an office/data role — the most-requested office skill in India.
courses.brief: Cells, formulas, IF, sorting, filtering and charts, with a working spreadsheet lab in every module.
learn: Workbooks, cells, ranges and clean formatting
Formulas, cell references and the dollar sign
SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT and ROUND
IF, AND, OR, COUNTIF and SUMIF for decisions
Sorting and filtering without breaking rows
Choosing, building and checking charts
courses.handsOn: Build a monthly shop report with totals, a target check, category summaries and a chart.
courses.outcome: Handle everyday spreadsheets at work or in study with confidence.

courses.title: Advanced Excel
courses.bestFor: Analysts, accountants, and managers who work in spreadsheets daily.
courses.brief: Lookups, SUMIFS, INDEX and MATCH, data cleaning, dates, pivot-style summaries, forecasts and finance, with a checked spreadsheet lab in every module.
learn: Mixed references, IFS, SWITCH and error handling
VLOOKUP, approximate matches, INDEX with MATCH and XLOOKUP
SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, AVERAGEIFS, rankings and SUMPRODUCT
Cleaning text, splitting codes and calculating with dates
Pivot-style summaries, charts that answer questions, trends and forecasts
Loans, NPV, IRR, break-even and a workbook you can share with confidence
courses.handsOn: Build a regional performance dashboard with SUMIFS, percent of target, a status, a rank, the best region and a chart.
courses.outcome: Analyse and report on real business data with the formulas professionals use every day.

courses.title: Excel Automation with Macros & VBA
courses.prereq: Advanced Excel; some comfort with formulas.
courses.bestFor: Finance/operations staff who repeat the same reports every week.
courses.brief: Record, read, write and debug VBA macros, with code to run in your own Excel and labs that train your thinking.

VBA building blocks: variables, types, MsgBox and InputBox
Workbooks, worksheets, ranges and finding the last row
If, Select Case, loops and arrays
Subs, Functions, error handling, debugging and events
Fast, safe, documented automation you can hand over
courses.handsOn: Write the design document for a safe, maintainable macro: inputs and outputs, procedure and safety.
courses.outcome: Plan, write and hand over macros that save real time.

courses.title: Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms)
courses.bestFor: Students, startups, and remote teams that collaborate online.
courses.brief: Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms and safe teamwork, with a practice lab in every module.

Writing structured Docs with styles, lists, tables and comments
Tracking data in Sheets with formulas, drop-downs and charts
Planning and presenting with Slides
Designing Forms and reading the results
A team way of working, Calendar, Meet and account safety
courses.handsOn: Write a one-page team project plan with a task table, a sharing plan and next steps.
courses.outcome: Run a small team project from one shared folder, confidently and safely.

courses.title: Microsoft Word — Professional Documents
courses.bestFor: Anyone creating resumes, reports, and business documents.
courses.brief: Formatting, structure, tables, letters, résumés and reports, with a document lab in every module.

Fonts, spacing, alignment and lists
Heading styles, page setup, headers and page numbers
Tables, pictures, captions and breaks
Letters, résumés, reports and meeting minutes
Proofreading, track changes, accessibility and PDF export

courses.outcome: Produce clear, professional documents for school or work.

courses.title: PowerPoint & Presentation Design
courses.bestFor: Students and professionals who pitch, report, or teach.

Layouts, themes and consistency
Headlines, readable text and speaker notes
Diagrams, shapes and honest charts
Openings, signposts, rehearsal and questions
Review checklists, accessibility and online delivery

courses.title: Data Analytics with Python & SQL
courses.prereq: Basic Excel and comfort with computers; no coding needed to start.

learn: The analysis workflow from question to decision
Python essentials and pandas: select, filter, create, clean
groupby, merge, pivot and window ideas, each paired with SQL
Funnels, cohort retention, RFM segmentation and deduplication in SQL
EDA, honest charts, confidence intervals, bias and Simpson's paradox
Parameterised queries, reproducible notebooks, privacy and communicating results

courses.outcome: Take a business question through a complete analysis and present a result people will act on.

courses.bestFor: Analysts, PMs, marketers — anyone who needs to pull their own data.

Expressions, CASE, dates and cleaning data in a query

Star-schema modelling, relationships and a proper date table
DAX measures, filter context, SUMX, RELATED and variables

Year to date, same period last year and growth

courses.outcome: Design models that give right answers, write the DAX a report needs, and plan reports people can read and trust.

courses.title: Data Visualization with Tableau

courses.title: Advanced Excel for Data Analysis
courses.bestFor: Analysts who prefer to stay in Excel before moving to BI tools.

Design KPI dashboards and write findings people act on

courses.outcome: Take messy data to a clear, honest recommendation, and explain every number.

courses.title: Statistics for Analysts & Data Science
courses.bestFor: Aspiring data analysts/scientists who want trustworthy results.

courses.outcome: Summarise data, quantify uncertainty and judge claims about relationships with care.
